title: YouTube Shorts Hit 200 Billion Views a Day

scenes.text: Every day, people watch 200 billion Shorts.
YouTube's CEO announced it in June 2025.
In March 2024, the number was 70 billion a day.
That's nearly triple in about 15 months.
It works out to more than two million views every second.
And you're watching one right now.

description:
